payload.title: babulus login through cli-login: secure-store session, remote login broker, WorkerAuth
payload.description: PR C of M2. Replaces the Cognito-password CLI path with cli-login 0.4.0 (login, login --remote, whoami, logout), a per-deployment broker and approval pages in the Studio Amplify backend (off until BABULUS_ENABLE_CLI_REMOTE_LOGIN), /.well-known/babulus-cli.json, and a WorkerAuth that uses the stored session. Cloud workers keep the job token.
